arguments.command: cd $GITHUB_WORKSPACE && git tag -a v0.36.0 -m "pit v0.36.0" adda0a0 && git push -q origin v0.36.0 &&

ops: sleep 30; for i in $(seq 1 40); do r=$(gh run list --workflow Release --branch v0.36.0 --json status,conclusion --jq '.[0]|.status+" "+.conclusion'); case "$r" in completed*) break;; esac; sleep 15; done; echo "$r"; gh release view v0.36.0 --json tagName,isDraft,assets,targetCommitish,url
